# Wirkstattnatur

Wirkstattnatur is the independent practice of Urs Gremlich in Thalwil and Horgen, Switzerland. Urs offers personal movement training, Pilates, Golf-Fitness and Karate. The practice combines movement, relaxation and nutrition in a personal training approach.

## Entity and contact

- Provider: Wirkstattnatur, Urs Gremlich
- Training location: Wirkraum, Zürcherstrasse 73, 8800 Thalwil, Switzerland
- Office: Hernerholzgasse 30, 8810 Horgen, Switzerland
- Phone: +41 79 413 18 30
- Email: info@wirkstattnatur.ch
- Map: https://www.google.ch/maps/place/Wirkstattnatur+-+Personal+Training+GolfFitness+Pilates+%26+Massage/@47.2860312,8.5608552,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m5!3m4!1s0x479aa8d2243337b5:0x50e540f490e6ac4b!8m2!3d47.2860312!4d8.5630439

## Source and data notes

The site has no analytics or advertising trackers. The Tidio chat widget is loaded as an optional contact channel; its data processing is described on the privacy pages. Service descriptions, prices, locations and biography should be treated as current website information and checked against the linked first-party pages before quoting them.
